_comment_purpose: Parallel model for Edict.Postgres.Tests. Mirrors Edict.Kafka.Tests: an assembly-shared Postgres testcontainer with per-fixture per-collection database isolation. Cluster fixtures run serially within the assembly because the provider-seam fixture plus the per-shape persistence-axis conformance fixtures stand up many Orleans clusters on a single host, and the silo-gateway initialisation races under that pressure.
